title: 10x Genomics PBMC 3k v1 filtered feature-barcode matrix

provenance.observations: Observed human peripheral blood mononuclear cells from a healthy donor, as described by Scanpy's legacy tutorial; tutorial reports 2,700 cells in its starting filtered matrix.
provenance.adaptations: Tutorial filters cells/genes, computes QC annotations and transforms expression. Pearson-residual tutorial uses the same PBMC3k v1 observations and provides an immutable download hash.
provenance.status: Observed source data; processed derivatives are tutorial-generated. Exact donor identity and collection design beyond healthy donor are unknown.

biological_context.assay: 10x Chromium single-cell gene expression UMI counts; v1 chemistry
biological_context.design: PBMC sample from a healthy human donor; donor count, collection conditions and technical replicates not reported in inspected sources
metadata: mitochondrial gene indicator and mitochondrial fraction in tutorial

assets.format: gzip tar archive containing filtered gene-barcode matrix in 10x MTX layout
assets.processing_stage: filtered feature-barcode matrix; tutorial starts at 2,700 cells and reports 32,738 genes before filtering in Pearson-residual walkthrough
assets.relationship: source asset; legacy tutorial's cf.10xgenomics.com URL resolves same named PBMC3k archive, but legacy tutorial does not pin hash

assets.version: tutorial derivative, no independent released version
assets.relationship: Derived in legacy workflow from the source asset; not bundled as the input data

access_and_terms.access_requirements: Public direct download URL; access was not attempted during this source inventory.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown from inspected documentation; public availability does not establish redistribution permission.

checked: Tutorial prose identifies healthy-donor 3k PBMC dataset and describes filtered matrix download.
Pearson-residual tutorial records archive URL and SHA256; reports 2,700 by 32,738 initial matrix before filtering.
not_checked: No archive downloaded, file previewed, hash independently verified, or workflow executed.

limitations: Detailed sample metadata, exact donor count/identity, complete sample processing record and file size were not recorded in inspected sources.
Redistribution eligibility requires a direct license/terms check by the task author.
The legacy source URL does not identify a checksum, although the matching v1.1.0 tutorial asset does.

title: PBMC3k tutorial marker-gene reference list

provenance.observations: Not a measurement dataset; marker identities and cell type associations are presented by the Scanpy PBMC3k tutorial and reused in the Pearson-residual example.
provenance.adaptations: Gene symbols are encoded as a short list in the tutorial for comparing variable gene selection and coloring embeddings.
provenance.status: Tutorial-supplied biological interpretation reference; the underlying differential expression analysis/table was not independently inspected here.

metadata: IL7R: CD4 T cells; LYZ/CD14: CD14+ monocytes; MS4A1: B cells; CD8A: CD8 T cells; GNLY/NKG7: NK cells; FCGR3A/MS4A7: FCGR3A+ monocytes; FCER1A/CST3: dendritic cells; PPBP: megakaryocytes

assets.format: 12 gene symbols and tutorial-asserted cell type associations
assets.processing_stage: reference labels used to interpret selected variable genes and cluster plots
assets.relationship: Derived from marker genes identified/presented in the PBMC3k tutorial; not independent of that tutorial's interpretation

access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown; short list appears in public documentation, no separate license analysis performed.

checked: Marker gene symbols and associated cell types in Pearson-residual tutorial lines 357-383.
not_checked: Underlying differential-expression table, reference cohort, or independent validation source.

limitations: These are interpretive markers rather than a comprehensive cell annotation truth set.
Do not treat the marker list as independent ground truth for automated grading without validation.
